Legal.cookieBannerText: We use cookies to keep our store running (cart, sign-in) and to understand how visitors use our site. See our cookie policy for details.
Legal.cookiePolicyIntro: This page explains what cookies and similar technologies (such as local storage) we use on Reptiles Concept and why.
Legal.cookiePolicyWhatBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They let a site remember information about your visit, like your preferences or the contents of your cart.
Legal.cookiePolicyEssentialBody: Needed for core features to work: keeping you signed in to your account or the staff area, and remembering the items in your cart and wishlist.
Legal.cookiePolicyFunctionalBody: Remember preferences such as your chosen language (French or English).
Legal.cookiePolicyAnalyticsBody: Help us understand which pages are visited so we can improve the site. We don't sell this information.
Legal.cookiePolicyControlBody: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent parts of the site (like the cart or checkout) from working properly.
Legal.cookiePolicyContactBody: Contact us using the details in the footer if you have any questions about this policy.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before visiting or ordering from Reptiles Concept.
Faq.pickup_a: All orders are prepared for pickup at our Lachine, QC location. Once your order is ready, we'll email you with our hours and a pickup deadline — please pick up within that window to avoid a cancellation fee.
Faq.shipping_a: Not yet — every order, animals and supplies alike, is for in-store pickup only in Lachine, QC.
Faq.payment_q: What payment methods do you accept?
Faq.payment_a: We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express online, plus Klarna for 4 interest-free installments. In store, we also accept cash.
Faq.healthGuarantee_q: What does your health guarantee cover?
Faq.healthGuarantee_a: Every animal is guaranteed healthy at the time of pickup. Please inspect your new pet in store before leaving — reach out right away if anything seems off.
Faq.care_q: Where can I learn how to care for my new pet?
Faq.care_a: Each animal's page includes a species care sheet (diet, humidity, temperature, enclosure size and more). Our team is also happy to walk you through setup in store.
Faq.returns_q: Can I return a live animal?
Faq.returns_a: For the animal's welfare, we don't accept returns on livestock once picked up. You can cancel an unpicked-up order before the pickup deadline — a cancellation fee may apply per our terms of sale.
Faq.afterSale_q: What if I have questions after bringing my pet home?
Faq.afterSale_a: We're here for the long run — contact us anytime using the details in the footer, whether it's a care question or something else.

About.title: About Reptiles Concept
About.subtitle: A specialty reptile shop in Lachine, Quebec, built on responsible breeding and real advice.
About.story: Reptiles Concept started with a simple idea: reptile and invertebrate keepers deserve a shop that actually knows the animals it sells. Every reptile, amphibian and invertebrate in our care is captive bred, healthy, and set up to thrive before it ever meets a customer.
About.mission: Our mission is to make responsible exotic pet ownership accessible — pairing every animal we sell with the care information, equipment and honest advice needed to give it a great life.
About.value_breeding_body: Captive bred, well socialized animals — never wild caught.
About.value_advice_body: Our team keeps and breeds what we sell, so the advice is lived-in.
About.value_community_body: Questions don't stop at pickup — we're here after you bring your pet home too.
